invariants.rationale: If parent is a Layout, its invalidateHierarchy() method is called, which should propagate invalidation until the hierarchy is valid, meaning needsLayout() should be false after return.
invalidate() sets this widget's layout as invalid, which should have been resolved by the end of the hierarchy invalidation process.
Control flow only branches on whether parent is Layout or not, but at this exit, parent cannot change type, so permissible types are null or Layout.
